_doc: Cut from planets/verdance/data/events.json in task M3-13 (docs/reviews/M3-13_TRIM.md): Supply Drop (already off: no reward crates from the sky), Robot Hiccup (pointed at robots, not at cleaning, pressing or tending; paid cubes and Parts for robot upkeep) and Wildlife Visit (its reward was a photo for the parked Collection, plus cubes and seeds). animals is the Wildlife Visit's table; wren holds their WREN pools. Their code is parked/side/events/events_cut.gd.

events.name: Supply Drop
events.toast: Supply Drop! A crate parachuted onto the junk %s of you. Clear the junk around it to crack it open.
events.hud: Clear the junk around the crate

events.name: Robot Hiccup
events.toast: %s has the hiccups and stopped working. Walk over and press E for a quick fix.
events.hud: Walk to the stuck robot and press E

events.name: Wildlife Visit
events.toast: Something is visiting a thriving hex %s of you. Sneak up and press E to take a photo.
events.hud: Find the visitor and press E for a photo

event_supply_drop: Crate inbound. From... me? I don't remember sending that. Open it.
Supply drop! I found an old Cradle pod still in orbit and nudged it down.
Another care package. I've been saving them for good days. This is one.
event_robot_hiccup: One of your helpers is stuck. Hic.
{robot} has the hiccups. Try a firm pat on the chassis.
event_wildlife_visit: Something alive is moving out there. Not a robot.
A visitor! Go slowly. Take a picture, it lasts longer.
The thriving hexes are calling things home. Look.
